title: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sents.t: Morales Debbie and her friends are tubing through a canal when they capture something creepy on camera.
sents.zh: Morales Debbie 和朋友们坐着游泳圈在运河里漂流时，镜头拍到了诡异的东西。

sents.t: The video was taken on July 8th of 2018, but prior to this date, about five years ago, someone had drowned in the same canal that Morales is in.
sents.zh: 视频拍摄于 2018 年 7 月 8 日，而大约五年前，就在 Morales 所在的这条运河里，有人溺水身亡。

sents.t: Little does she know that she and her friends would capture something disturbing.
sents.zh: 她完全没想到，她和朋友们会拍到让人不安的东西。

sents.t: It was only after posting the video on Facebook and being told by viewers about this that she noticed.
sents.zh: 直到把视频发到 Facebook、观众告诉她之后，她才注意到。

sents.t: Viewers think that this might have been the ghost of the victim who had drowned.
sents.zh: 观众认为，这可能是那位溺水者的鬼魂。

sents.t: Others think that this could have been something else, perhaps a creature.
sents.zh: 也有人认为可能是别的东西，也许是某种生物。

sents.t: No one knows for sure, but it seems like more people believe that this might be the spirit of the deceased.
sents.zh: 没人能确定，但似乎更多人相信那是死者的灵魂。

sents.t: But of course, what are your thoughts?
